description: Gritty grounded Chinese folk-horror realism rendered as rain-soaked lacquered wood, weathered bronze and layered mineral-pigment surfaces; heavy silhouettes edged by restrained dry-brush charcoal marks; environment in blue-black wet stone, soot and desaturated indigo, lantern bearer in warm aged-brass and parchment tones, hostile spirits in oxidized teal, irreversible danger in vermilion cord; oppressive cold rain, dense low mist and hard warm lantern pools; high contrast between interactive ritual signals and subdued backgrounds, clean readable silhouettes, consistent top-down perspective across all assets.
Flooded ancestral shrine courtyard with lacquered threshold, collapsed incense burner, wet slate and three distant ritual lantern stations
Worn indigo-robed lantern bearer carrying a scarred bronze lantern and a bundle of wet memorial slips; relative_scale 1.0
Torn funeral-paper puppet with bamboo ribs, water-stained talismans and visible stitched mouth; relative_scale 0.9
Mask-wearing ritual carrier holding a leaking oxidized-teal soul lantern; relative_scale 1.15
Sodden bell wraith wrapped in crimson cord and ash paper; relative_scale 1.05
Ritual colossus assembled from charred lantern frames, mourning cloth and teal fire; relative_scale 2.4
Weathered bronze shrine lantern on a black stone plinth, three readable vow seals around its base; relative_scale 1.5
Folded wet memorial slip sealed with oxidized-teal wax, readable collectible; relative_scale 0.32
Three ritual decree seals for 镇守, 借影 and 焚谶; aged brass, soaked paper and vermilion cord; large readable symbols
Concentric wet-stone ripple, brass seal geometry, ash motes and rain impact circles
Delayed amber silhouette replay, teal afterimage trail and paper-ash fracture at impact
Layered oblique cold rain, low volumetric mist, soft vignette and occasional lantern bloom; no screen-obscuring sheets

type: Sparse bowed metal, rain on roof tiles, distant funeral bell and low breath-like drone
